name: middleton
description: Free Claude plugins from Kevin Middleton: a second brain for work, a job search agent, a personal-site builder, and a phone-to-app setup guide.

plugins.name: unpaid-intern
plugins.description: Unpaid Intern: a free second brain for work. Turns your meeting transcripts, docs, tickets, and email into a morning briefing, meeting prep, status updates, and follow-ups with owners and dates, all in plain files you own. Guided setup, and it works with as much or as little as your company allows, from fully connected to chat only.

plugins.name: job-search-agent
plugins.description: A lightweight, on-demand job search toolkit: saved searches across company job boards, on-demand scans, scored postings with an apply-or-skip verdict, a local application tracker, and role-specific interview guides.

plugins.name: personal-site
plugins.description: Build a distinctive personal website through a guided interview, from an editorial backbone and a palette that keeps sites from looking alike to a launch walkthrough that ends live on GitHub Pages.

plugins.name: build-with-claude
plugins.description: A guide that walks non-technical people through setting up Claude Code with Telegram, so they can build apps from their phone.
